technical-summary: rad_add_plugin hashes each HIP source's -cuid from its path relative to the component source dir; libr3/libr2 unit wrappers live in the build tree, whose path holds the build-plan id, so every new plan changed every unit's command line and no libr3/libr2 unit ever hit ccache (CI: 142 misses on a PR that did not touch libr3; r4d_gemm_iqr alone 35 min). r3_build_tree_cuid re-hashes the cuid from the wrapper's path inside the build tree (unique, location-independent); configure fails if rad_add_plugin stops setting -cuid. Also the radiance-build trigger patterns (PR and push, kept identical, with a test): added inputs the build reads (build CLI, source materialisation, patch application/evidence, release preflight, recipes/release config, ci_ccache.py) and dropped paths it never reads (engines/radiance/tests, archs/layouts/model_constant_guard tomls).
user-summary-candidate: CI and local builds reuse cached libr3/libr2 kernel compiles again, so most radiance PR builds no longer recompile the 20-35 minute kernel units.
